capabilities: Insert a timestamp into a list item by typing -[t] and pressing Space
Continue timestamped lists automatically when pressing Enter
Add or remove timestamps on any line via a toggle hotkey
Configure the time format using dayjs tokens and choose UTC or local time
extras: Defaults to UTC timestamps, which may surprise users expecting local time; format follows dayjs syntax.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to stamp list items with the current time while taking quick notes.
summary: Timestamped-bullet plugin that inserts current times into list items as you type, continues them on Enter, and toggles them via hotkey.
